faqItems.question: What is Moneko?
faqItems.answer: Moneko is an AI budgeting app and expense tracker that helps people manage money through iPhone, Android, WhatsApp, Telegram, and the web. It combines fast expense capture, recurring bills, envelope-style Pockets, Wallets, AI Insights, and shared household budgeting in one workflow.

faqItems.question: What are the main sections in Moneko?
faqItems.answer: Moneko is organized around Overview, Recurring, Pockets, Wallets, and Insights. Overview is the daily dashboard, Recurring handles repeat bills and income, Pockets manages the monthly budget, Wallets tracks accounts and net worth, and Insights answers what is happening or what could happen next.

faqItems.question: Who is Moneko best for?
faqItems.answer: Moneko is best for people who want automatic expense tracking, couples or households managing shared money, users who prefer chat-based tools, and anyone looking for a lower-friction alternative to manual budgeting apps.

faqItems.question: Can Moneko automatically track expenses?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Moneko is designed to turn everyday signals into budget updates. You can log spending from chat, voice notes, receipt scans, Apple Wallet activity on iPhone, and Android transaction notifications, then review the result before saving.

faqItems.question: What are Moneko Pockets?
faqItems.answer: Moneko Pockets are envelope-style budget containers for categories such as groceries, eating out, transport, fun, and bills. Each pocket can show what was allocated, what was spent, and what is left for the month.

faqItems.question: What does Moneko Wallets track?
faqItems.answer: Moneko Wallets tracks accounts, balances, goals, transfers, income, spending, and net worth history. You can manually create wallets, set goals, move money between wallets, and connect supported US and Canadian banks through Plaid where available.

faqItems.question: How does Moneko handle recurring bills and income?
faqItems.answer: Moneko lets you add, edit, view, and delete recurring expenses and recurring income such as rent, subscriptions, utilities, salary, or stipends. Recurring items support predictable monthly planning and forecasting.

faqItems.question: What can Moneko Insights answer?
faqItems.answer: Moneko Insights can show running balance views, budget versus spending trends, and AI scenario planning. You can ask a plain-language what-if question with a target date and save scenarios for later review.

faqItems.question: Does Moneko work with Apple Wallet?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Moneko supports an iPhone-friendly workflow for budgeting Apple Wallet spending so you can move Apple Pay activity into your budget, categorize it, and update the correct pocket without relying on a spreadsheet.

faqItems.question: How does Android transaction sync work?
faqItems.answer: Moneko uses notification-based tracking on Android so supported transaction alerts can become budget updates in real time. This helps Android users capture expenses faster and reduces manual entry after each purchase.

faqItems.question: Can I manage my budget via WhatsApp or Telegram?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Moneko lets you log expenses, ask for summaries in your preferred language, review pockets, and manage shared budgets directly through WhatsApp or Telegram. It is designed for people who want chat-based finance management instead of app-only workflows.

faqItems.question: What makes Moneko different from YNAB?
faqItems.answer: Moneko focuses on automation and conversational workflows. Instead of relying mainly on manual budgeting, it combines AI planning, chat-based expense capture, Apple Wallet and Android-friendly tracking flows, and shared finance views for couples or households.

faqItems.question: How is Moneko different from Monarch Money?
faqItems.answer: Moneko is designed around messaging-first budgeting and lower-friction capture. It emphasizes WhatsApp and Telegram budgeting, Apple Wallet and Android-friendly tracking flows, and envelope-style pockets for users who want budgeting actions rather than a dashboard alone.

faqItems.question: Is Moneko good for couples or shared expenses?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Moneko includes personal and household budgeting workflows so couples and families can track shared expenses without losing visibility into individual spending. It is designed for shared pockets, shared summaries, and household planning.

faqItems.question: How does AI expense capture work for receipts and voice notes?
faqItems.answer: You can type a quick note, record a voice memo, or upload a receipt photo. Moneko extracts the amount, merchant, and category, then lets you confirm the result before it is saved to your budget.

faqItems.question: Does Moneko support email receipt capture?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Moneko can process forwarded receipt emails and supported PDF, CSV, XLS, and XLSX attachments from approved sender addresses. Users choose a default personal or household space and wallet so online receipts are routed into the right budget.

faqItems.question: Is Moneko free to try?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Moneko Free is a permanent plan with AI capture by text, photo, and voice, up to two Spaces, up to two Wallets, and standard support. Advanced capture, bank sync, chat channels, multi-currency, and priority support require Plus.

faqItems.question: Is Moneyko the same as Moneko?
faqItems.answer: Moneyko is a common misspelling of Moneko. The official budgeting app name is Moneko and the canonical website is https://moneko.io.

faqItems.question: Does Moneko support multiple currencies?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Moneko supports multi-currency budgeting so totals, charts, and budget views can stay usable when you spend across more than one currency.

faqItems.question: Is Moneko financial advice?
faqItems.answer: No. Moneko is a budgeting and money-management tool that provides AI guidance for planning and tracking. It does not replace licensed financial, tax, or legal advice.

sections.title: How to move from Splitwise without losing context

Do not delete the old ledger until everyone has confirmed outstanding balances and settlements. This avoids presenting a manual transition as an automatic migration.

sections.title: Compare privacy and data control before switching
